# 🚀 CI/CD Workflows

GitHub Actions workflows cho dự án IOES.

## Workflows (sẽ tạo)

| Workflow | Mô tả |
|----------|-------|
| `ci-frontend.yml` | CI cho Frontend (lint, test, build) |
| `ci-backend-java.yml` | CI cho Java services |
| `ci-backend-node.yml` | CI cho Node.js services |
| `ci-backend-python.yml` | CI cho Python services |
| `cd-production.yml` | CD deploy production |
| `security-scan.yml` | Security scanning (Trivy, Snyk) |
| `load-test.yml` | Performance testing (k6) |
| `code-quality.yml` | SonarQube code quality |

## Status
